name: Gaseous Form
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by enchanted creature.

needs.what: a damage_source (dealer) filter on the prevent_damage static, so 'prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by enchanted creature' is {effect: prevent_damage, prevent_all: true, combat_only: true, damage_source: {attached: true}} -- prevention keyed on the source rather than the recipient, applied wherever combat damage is dealt (to players and permanents alike)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage static with prevent_all + combat_only covers the 'dealt to' half via affects: {attached: true}, but its affects is the recipient only; damage_source exists only on replace_damage, which the loader refuses with a damage_multiplier below 2 (0 would be prevention). The prevent_damage_permanent op has a 'dealt' option but is a one-shot with a duration, not a static that lasts while the Aura is attached
